_comment: THE ROOM. Everything here is a property of the space, not of the rig -- so a
new room is a new venue file and nothing else changes. Millimetres, y up,
origin at the front-left floor corner.
crowd_zone and canopy are consumed by the beam-aware intensity taper (F4).
They are the answer to the two things that actually went wrong on the night:
beams caught people in the eye, and the parachute clipped the aerials' throw.
MEASURE THESE ON SITE. The numbers below are the despacio room as built, and
the head band is a stated assumption rather than a measurement -- see its
name: despacio room
_apex_comment: The point directly above the ball that the aerial poses converge on. With a
parachute rigged this is the canopy height and the beams land ON it and it
glows; without one it is the ceiling.
_crowd_zone_comment: Where people stand, and how high their eyes are. The taper drives intensity
to zero for any beam whose cone enters the head band inside this footprint,
with a soft edge outside it.
head_band_min/max is 1.4-2.0 m: roughly seated-tall to standing-tall. It is
a judgement call, not a measurement, and it is deliberately generous at the
top -- someone on someone's shoulders is exactly who gets hit. Raising the
floor of the band buys back throw at the cost of catching shorter people.
The footprint is inset from the walls because the corners hold the heads
themselves and nobody stands in them.
